title: Counterarguments
description: Acknowledge opposing views and respond with measured rebuttal.

introduction.headline: Handle opposing views
introduction.body: Practise conceding limited ground, then refuting with stronger evidence.
introduction.bodyIt: Pratica a concedere terreno limitato e poi confutare con prove più solide.

vocabulary.example: A strong essay anticipates the main counterargument.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Un saggio solido anticipa la principale controargomentazione.

vocabulary.example: We can concede that costs will rise initially.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Possiamo concedere che i costi aumenteranno inizialmente.

vocabulary.example: Her rebuttal focused on the quality of the data.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La sua replica si è concentrata sulla qualità dei dati.

exercises.prompt: What does concede mean in argumentation?
options: Admit a limited point while keeping your overall position
exercises.answer: Admit a limited point while keeping your overall position
exercises.explanation: To concede is to accept a limited opposing point without abandoning your case.

exercises.prompt: A careful ____ addresses the strongest opposing claim.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: A careful ____ addresses the strongest opposing claim.
exercises.explanation: A rebuttal responds directly to an opposing argument.

review.tip: State one opposing view, concede one detail, then rebut with evidence.
